description: Section 8.2, the five placement rules in one chat: a fresh first message, a reply by In-Reply-To, a new fresh subject, an Outlook reply without headers found by subject, a prefixed reply with a new subject, named topics from ES parts, a reply whose In-Reply-To is outside the chat but whose References reaches the chat, an ES part's topicRoot winning over In-Reply-To, an empty subject, a fresh mail with an existing subject, and a topicRoot that is not in the chat.
